- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure HCI without ubicomp framing
- Pure IoT engineering without HCI angle
- AI use without disclosure per Springer policy

### Soft Tax

Low for ubicomp tradition.

### Best Suited For

- Mobile HCI empirical research
- Wearable interaction studies
- IoT user experience research
- Smart environment design
- Context-aware computing
- Field deployment studies

### Not Recommended For

- Pure HCI usability (consider TOCHI)
- Pure IoT engineering (consider IEEE)
- Pure ubicomp engineering without user studies

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction](./acm-transactions-on-computer-human-interaction.md) | ACM SIGCHI flagship |
| 2 | [ACM PACM IMWUT](../hci/acm-pacm-imwut.md) | UbiComp/ISWC proceedings journal |
| 3 | [International Journal of Human-Computer Studies](./international-journal-of-human-computer-studies.md) | Elsevier cognitive-HCI |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from TOCHI as "too ubicomp-specialized," PUC is the Springer home for personal/ubicomp HCI.
